SELECT 
    buyer_country, 
    lane_class, 
    SUM(sum_bwt) / SUM(parcel_qty) AS avg_BWT, 
    SUM(sum_apt) / SUM(parcel_qty) AS avg_APT,
    (SUM(sum_bwt) / SUM(parcel_qty)) - (SUM(sum_apt) / SUM(parcel_qty)) AS avg_transit
FROM spx
WHERE lane_class IN ('Intra-region', 'Island-crossing')
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
